name: cortico-world-humanize
description: Cortico World for Coopanion: before the pet answers, reads the situation, mood and the pet's own memory and hands it a short inner thought, and reminds it when it slips into stock AI sentence patterns
author: abbabanana

zh.description: 桌宠开口前，先读一下情境、心情和它自己的记忆，递给它一句「此刻心里的想法」；它要是用了「不是……而是……」、先复述你的话这类 AI 固定句式，下次就提醒它换个说法。口癖、语气、长短都不碰。搭配「活人感 provider」效果最好。

en.description: Before the pet answers, reads the situation, mood and the pet's own memory and hands it a short inner thought; when it slips into stock AI sentence patterns ("not X but Y", parroting your words back), it is reminded to say it another way next time. Catchphrases, tone and length are left alone. Works best with the Humanize provider.
